meta.provenance_note: Codebook-only prompt v1.3.1; temperature not API-controlled in this harness.

premises.text: PII-laden files create large per-record breach costs, yet teams lack easy company-wide file visibility
premises.evidence_span: A single piece of personal identifiable information, known as PII, can cost an organization $186 per record

premises.text: Traditional DLP is slow to deploy and rules-based, encoding months of potential human error
premises.evidence_span: When it comes to deploying a traditional data loss prevention tool, 98% of organizations take more than a few weeks

premises.text: Phalanx identity-based automation encrypts unused files while users keep familiar access patterns for files in use
premises.evidence_span: Those 999 unused secured files don't impact your productivity. However, it completely hinders the ability to steal that data

premises.text: Workspace-wide file access mapping with geofenced controls and API export to existing monitors is core to the product
premises.evidence_span: If somebody's opening a file in a country that you don't have an office, you can restrict that from opening

premises.text: Sold per user to mid/large enterprises and through channel partners into SMBs
premises.evidence_span: focus on mid- to large-scale enterprise by doing per-user requirements, so we're scalable with the needs of those security teams, and we can also deploy out to SMBs via the channel

domains.name: File exposure and slow DLP status quo

value.text: Protect organizational data without making security fight productivity
value.evidence_span: Phalanx's mission focuses on the core problem that users have to make security decisions, and they pit that against productivity decisions

causal_links.evidence_span: security isn't useful if it's not used

notes: Third pass: deployment-speed claim folded into contrast with traditional DLP (P2) plus identity product (P3) rather than standalone premise.
